scripts.export-zip: next build && powershell -Command "Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; if (Test-Path 'neon-rush-html5.zip') { Remove-Item 'neon-rush-html5.zip' -Force }; [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::CreateFromDirectory((Resolve-Path 'out'), (Join-Path (Get-Location) 'neon-rush-html5.zip'))"
